description: Defines the DrmInfo class and related iterators for handling DRM server transaction information within the Android DRM framework.

classes.name: DrmInfo
classes.description: Utility class representing DRM transaction information, including methods for managing attributes and iterators.

classes.name: DrmInfo::KeyIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing keys in DrmInfo attributes.

classes.name: DrmInfo::Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing values in DrmInfo attributes.

methods.name: DrmInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing DRM info with type, data, and MIME type.

methods.name: getInfoType
methods.description: Returns the type of DRM information.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type associated with the DRM info.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the DRM info attributes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key.

methods.name: keyIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the attribute keys.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the attribute values.

methods.name: indexOfKey
methods.description: Returns the index of a specified key.
